newsitem.title: FRANCE: EU grain export commitments up on last year.
newsitem.headline: EU grain export commitments up on last year.

text.p: Latest European Union figures show grain export commitments between July 1 and December 17, 1996 were 24 percent above their year-ago level, mostly the result of higher wheat and barley sales, member-country officials said on Monday.
The figures, based on delivered export certificates, showed grain exports ahead on last year at 15.533 million tonnes against 12.517 million.
Commercial soft wheat export commitments reached 5.418 million tonnes, up from 4.269 million in the same period last year.
Commercial barley exports jumped to 3.112 million tonnes from 1.174 million during the same period last year, helped by sales to Saudi Arabia.
Flour exports were ahead on last year at 3.609 million tonnes against 2.918 million.
Malt exports fell to 1.810 million tonnes from 2.182 million tonnes.
Commercial oat commitments reached 213,000 tonnes against 36,000 tonnes during the same period last year.

Since December 17, the EU has authorised 397,500 tonnes of soft wheat, 258,961 tonnes of barley, 11,000 tonnes of rye and 13,300 tonnes of durum wheat exports through its weekly grain tender system. --Paris newsroom +331 4221 5432
